newsitem.title: KENYA: 14 people killed in Rwandan ambush - agency.
newsitem.headline: 14 people killed in Rwandan ambush - agency.

text.p: Fourteen people were killed in western Rwanda when gunmen ambushed them at a roadblock and set their vehicles ablaze, the private Rwandan News Agency said on Tuesday.

The agency, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation, said former Rwandan Hutu soldiers and Interahamwe militiamen who recently returned to Rwanda from Zaire and led the country's 1994 genocide were believed to be responsible.
Quoting military sources, it said the ambush took place on Monday in Kivumu commune in the western province of Kibuye and was the third by former Interahamwe militiamen in the area in four months.

Some 100,000 Rwandan Hutu refugees, who fled Rwanda in 1994 in fear of reprisals for the genocide of an estimated 800,000 Tutsis and Hutu moderates, have returned to Rwanda from Zaire so far this year.
More than 100,000 Rwandan Hutus, including some of those who returned this year from Zaire, are held in overcrowded Rwandan jails and lock-ups accused of involvement in the genocide.
